title: A pane holds tabs of any window
body:
A pane holds one client (`Pane.toplevel` in `src/panes.rs`). Jack wants a pane to hold several windows of any kind, such as terminals or several preview programs, and show one at a time.

## Proposal

A pane holds a list of clients and the index of the one shown. A strip on the pane's top row lists them. A new window can be opened as a tab of the focused pane. Hidden clients keep their size and get no frame callbacks.

## Open

- How a window becomes a tab rather than a new pane: a key, a palette action, or a drop target on the Ctrl bar drag.
- What a pane tab's name is, and how the socket addresses a client in a tab.

This comes after workspace tabs (decade-1ba809). Jack ranks it the least important feature of this round.
close_reason: Landed in e2173eb. Super+Shift+T, Super+Shift+[ and ], a strip of window titles on the pane's top row, terminal tab directories saved in workspaces.toml v2. Tab order after a restore follows the order the windows arrive in.
